verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Superset publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a TypeScript SDK, a CLI and an MCP server, but nothing documents an interactive API reference (such as a try-it console) or runnable examples. A raw OpenAPI spec is a building block an explorer could be built on, not the interactive reference itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
